construction.source_description: Russian Web Tables (RWT), described by the dataset repository as tables from Russian Wikipedia.
construction.selection_and_labeling: Relational tables selected by headers matching 170 DBpedia semantic types; treat labels as weak/header-derived annotations, not independently verified gold labels.
construction.split: Fixed train/test split. Keep all 115,448 test columns sealed and exclude them from training and mapping decisions.

licensing.unresolved_issue: The LoReTA repository and Hugging Face card report MIT, but the upstream RWT repository lists no license file and describes data extracted from Russian Wikipedia. The source-page attribution/provenance mapping and rights for embedded table content have not been confirmed. Do not treat the MIT label as clearing every underlying table.
licensing.upstream_repository_listing: README.md and dataset.zip; no LICENSE file is listed.
licensing.upstream_readme_note: The upstream RWT repository describes the corpus as extracted from Russian Wikipedia and asks users to cite its paper; it does not state a dataset license in the README.
licensing.underlying_source_license: Russian Wikipedia contributions at the RWT corpus's September 13, 2021 snapshot were under CC BY-SA 3.0; Wikimedia moved future text contributions to CC BY-SA 4.0 in 2023. Verify each reused page/revision and any imported-content exceptions.
licensing.attribution_requirement: Wikimedia Terms of Use allow attribution by a link/URL to the reused page or pages; retain that page-level attribution and a license notice.
licensing.rwt_corpus_license: No license file is listed in the upstream RWT corpus repository. The separate MIT tag on LoReTA/RuTaBERT does not establish permission to redistribute the upstream RWT database/selection.
licensing.table_id_mapping: The RuTaBERT card preview exposes IDs like dataset/Dataset/data/1000006/table_0. The RWT paper says its surrogate table ID contains a Wikipedia page ID and table offset and that metadata stores source URL/page title, but that ID-to-source mapping has not been verified against the upstream archive.
licensing.clearance_blocker: Verify the RuTaBERT table IDs against RWT's per-table source metadata, preserve source page/revision and applicable historical license/attribution for every selected table, and establish permission to reuse the RWT corpus/selection itself. Until then, keep all 1,441,349 columns out of label staging.

relevance: Large multilingual column-classification candidate that may add Russian headers and examples. DBpedia labels require a reviewed mapping to LABEL_GUIDE.md; unmappable labels must remain unmapped.
handling: Do not download, redistribute, label, or import into materials/pool/batch_*.jsonl until the table-ID-to-page attribution map, RWT corpus rights, underlying Wikipedia license/version, PII screen, label quality, and deduplication are resolved. If cleared, split only the train portion into bounded staging chunks, preserve CC BY-SA attribution/licensing, and keep all 115,448 test columns sealed.
